contentPattern.structure: horizontal row of icon + linked label items

suitableFor: icon quick-nav / jump-link bars below a hero
horizontal rows of icon + label links to child topic pages
sub-topic detail pages that need an in-section topic navigation band

notes: New variant for the topic-hub-subnav template. Source renders duplicate desktop and mobile copies of the bar; the parser must emit a single clean set of items. Icons in the source are Material Icons ligature names (warning_amber, list_alt, medical_services, diversity_1, menu_book); the decorate() supports either EDS icon spans or an icon token per row and renders a single horizontal <ul> of links.
